title: What it means to be a Founder

media.alt: Slide 1 of 6, a deep green slide with the Fore Motion Golf logo at the top: What it means to be a Founder. Belonging, access, recognition and community. Swipe. foremotiongolf.com at the foot.
Slide 2, a cream slide with the logo at the top, labeled Being a Founder: First through the doors. A Founding Membership is joining before Fore Motion Golf opens in early 2027.
Slide 3, a deep green slide labeled Being a Founder: A name on the Founders Wall. Founders are recognized on the Founders Wall, from the beginning.
Slide 4, a cream slide labeled Being a Founder: Founding Member, permanently. Your membership runs for its term. Your Founding Member designation stays.
Slide 5, a deep green slide labeled Being a Founder: Priority invitations. Priority access to leagues and events, and exclusive Founding Member merchandise.

Slide 6, a cream slide with the logo at the top: Founding Memberships are limited. First access goes to the Founders List. A bright green Join the Founders List button, then the line Limited availability. Benefits and terms governed by the Founding Membership Agreement. foremotiongolf.com at the foot.
